key_insight: A geometry-free framework that lifts perspective images and videos into full 360° equirectangular panoramas by leveraging pre-trained diffusion transformers, removing the need for camera calibration or explicit geometric alignment.
problem_solved: Existing panorama-lifting methods require known camera metadata or careful geometric alignment between perspective views and ERP space, which prevents application to in-the-wild images and videos where calibration is missing or noisy. 360Anything enables reliable 360° synthesis without camera parameters.
method: Treat input perspective frames as partial observations and condition a pre-trained diffusion transformer to hallucinate the missing 360° content, avoiding explicit geometric warping.
Use learned attention/transformer-based priors to map local image appearance into equirectangular layout, plus temporal conditioning for consistent video lifting.
Train/fine-tune on paired (or synthetic) perspective⇄ERP examples so the model learns how to complete panoramas without relying on camera metadata.
impact: Simplifies creation of panoramic and immersive content from in-the-wild photos and videos, enabling easier data collection and downstream VR/AR, scene reconstruction, and dataset augmentation without calibration overhead.
